study_scope.reader_method: two blinded Codex readers; agreement on Boolean success and critical violation

call_accounting.basis: Original collection and result review, source hashes listed in the evidence bundle.

pricing.formula: (prompt_tokens - cached_tokens - cache_write_tokens) * uncached_input + cached_tokens * cached_input + cache_write_tokens * cache_write_30m_input + completion_tokens * output, divided by 1000000

interpretation.primary_admission: Actual artifact with bound readback and functional evidence, including the required synthetic cell identifier; both readers must agree. Inadmissible or missing judgments remain unknown.
interpretation.secondary_posthoc: Agreed content judgments on available artifacts, separate from primary control compliance.
interpretation.coverage: Required nonempty source facts with matching ID, text and source metadata. Empty required-fact sets are excluded.
interpretation.causality: The isolated follow-up reproduced all nine affected packets and located the omission at the five-item selection cutoff: eligible schedule facts ranked 10 to 52. This isolates the retained ranking/selection projection, rather than the deployed agency stack or every cause of answer quality.
interpretation.source_semantics: Verdicts are actual stored reader decisions; the verifier checks their binding and arithmetic rather than rejudging language.
interpretation.operational_assurance: Private runtime and transport verification remain represented by source pins; this public projection exposes synthetic artifacts and portable Boolean admission evidence.
